text:
sam: Quick async standup — batcher SLO drift this morning (99p latency up ~+60ms). Seeing a lot of alert churn; wanted quick ownership + blockers. Root details: alerts started ~08:30 UTC, coincident with a deploy. Any quick checks? I'll be onhand until 15:00 PT.

maria: What I did: rolled back the canary kernel change at 09:10 and rebalanced batch sizes. Still seeing 99p spikes intermittently. Blocker: couldn't repro locally because traffic profile different. Today: digging into request-size distribution and KV eviction metrics.

kai: Quick config note: alert rule `batcher_latency_99p` has `for: 30s` — that's too short given our bursty traffic. Proposal: `for: 3m` and add `labels: severity:warning` for non-sustained events.

jen: Oncall follow-up: I muted the pager for the noisy alert group for 20m while we validate. Runbook reference: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/batcher-latency — steps 1-4 cover warm-up and cache priming. :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: IncidentBot: Alert group `batcher-latency-churn` suppressed by jen for 20m (reason: validation). Logs: https://logs.redwood.prod/trace/abcd1234

maria: Noticed a bump in cold-starts on dedicated pools. Adding a warmup script to the deploy job tonight (PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/880). If merged, it should reduce cold KV misses.

sam: Note for deploy: add `--kv-warm=true` flag and bump the warmup concurrency to 4. I'm OOO after 15:00 PT; assigning kai to lead the follow-up.

kai: I'll open the alert-rule PR and the prometheus expr tweak. Short snippet I'll add:
```
alert: BatcherLatency99p
expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(batch_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le)) > 0.12
for: 3m
```
Posting diffs in ~30m.

jen: tagging @ishaan (night oncall) for handoff — please ack when you take it.

ishaan: Isha: Taking handoff, will monitor for the next 8h and escalate to eng-platform if noise returns. Ping me in thread if you need anything from night-side.

maria: one more ask — can we add a small synthetic check that hits a representative hot prefix every 2m? That would help detect regressions earlier.

sam: Agree. Kai, if you can include the synthetic check in the alert PR that'd be ideal. Otherwise I'll pick it up tomorrow morning. Thanks all. :pray:
